summary: The parent guardian emphasizes the importance of the E-Rate program for their library and community, and requests continued commitment to ensure libraries have access to federal funds.

claims.argument: If E-Rate funding is terminated, libraries will be forced to reduce programs and services to continue providing internet access.
claims.evidence_quote: If the FCC terminates or limits E-Rate funding, my library will be forced to reduce programs and services in order to continue providing internet access.
